content: GHCR CI pattern: actions/checkout@v4/v5, docker/setup-buildx-action v4.2.0, docker/login-action v4.4.0 with GITHUB_TOKEN (packages:write), docker/metadata-action v6.2.0 for tags (sha + semver), docker/build-push-action v7.3.0 with cache-from/to type=gha,mode=max. Next.js: output standalone, multi-stage Dockerfile, copy .next/standalone + .next/static, node server.js.
